Exo 2 (github.com/google/fonts ofl/exo2/Exo2[wght].ttf, Copyright 2013 The Exo 2 Project Authors) and Cinzel
(ofl/cinzel/Cinzel[wght].ttf, Copyright 2020 The Cinzel Project Authors), both SIL Open Font License 1.1 with no
Reserved Font Name (OFL-Exo2.txt, OFL-Cinzel.txt). 3.0.18-beta.193: the launcher's words (Exo 2 Medium, SemiBold,
Bold, ExtraBold) and its wordmark (Cinzel Bold) - static instances of the variable fonts, subset to Latin, Cyrillic and
the punctuation the words use, made by tools/launcher_fonts.py (fontTools 4.63); in uaro-graphics.exe as resources
(src/app/app.rc), loaded privately with AddFontMemResourceEx. Exo 2 has no arrows, stars or ticks: the launcher draws
those characters in Segoe UI.
